failure_modes: Treating the teacher-mode dispersion as an intramolecular distance or mixture bandwidth would mis-specify curvature.
Selecting an exploratory neighbor or delta value without observed support would be an unsupported spatial-emphasis edit.
rationale: The supplied teacher-mode dispersion (assignment RMS quantiles 0.0446/0.0863/0.1050 nm) is an observed spatial scale of the registered teacher modes, not an intramolecular distance statistic and not a mixture-bandwidth estimate. The incumbent already encodes a spatial emphasis through core_radius_A=5.0 and geometry_block_weights [0,1,2,1] with teacher_neighbors=4 and pointcloud_delta_A=1.0 A, which are consistent with the observed sub-0.11 nm mode dispersion. No supplied evidence justifies changing the distance-response curvature or spatial emphasis, and the allowed edits (teacher_neighbors, pointcloud_delta_A) are exploratory choices rather than observed scales. Retaining the incumbent avoids an unsupported curvature change; the expected response range is unchanged.
